t: This is Garrick Yard, a small alley in Covent Garden, in the City of Westminster. It is named after David Garrick, the eighteenth-century British actor, playwright and theatre manager. Garrick wrote, produced and influenced nearly all aspects of theatrical practice in his time, and he was a pupil and friend of Samuel Johnson. He caught the notice of audiences and managers with his appearance in the title role of Shakespeare's Richard the Third. That theatrical history suits this corner of Covent Garden.
